L22·N2979unmasked layer
Fires on the delimiter/preposition token immediately **before** a numeral — colons in times, commas in value lists, " to"/" on" introducing dates or ranges, and bare spaces preceding digits (e.g. " 800m", " 1Sky"); i.e. a structural "next token is a number" position rather than a semantic concept.
